title.narrative: Maharashtra Project on Climate Resilient Agriculture Phase - II

description.narrative: Improve Resilience and promote sustainable agriculture with the following four pillars viz: Pillar 1 - Resource Efficient Productivity Enhancement; Pillar 2 - Promoting Precision Agriculture for Emissions Management; Pillar 3- Improving and Building Income Resilience; Pillar 4 - Lighthouse Approach for Strengthening Institutions. The details of these pillars will be discussed with the client and the task team, will be finalised during project preparation.
The Project Development Objective (PDO) is to improve resilience and profitability of smallholder farmers across selected districts in Maharashtra.
